children: California Attorney General Rob Bonta served an investigative subpoena on Nvidia
related to former CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese operative.
The California Department of Justice plans to investigate if Nvidia misled investors regarding whether its advanced GPUs or confidential information made it to China.

"The conduct of Nvidia and its former CEO raises bright red flags, including about the ways in which the company may have misled investors," Bonta said. "My office is investigating whether Nvidia or Jensen Huang's actions resulted in China obtaining advanced chips or confidential information—and if Nvidia misled investors and the public about this risk, in violation of the law. Nvidia is in a messy, transnational situation, but the underlying principle of our corporate securities law is clear: companies cannot mislead their investors."

title: Calif. AG serves Nvidia investigative subpoena over China issues
